title: Presales Executive
description:
**Job Description – Business Development Executive**

**Company:** Digital Marketing Agency  
**Position:** Business Development Executive  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Dashrath puri, delhi

About the Role

We are looking for a **Business Development Executive** with experience in **B2B sales, service-based sales, or digital marketing sales**. The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential clients, generating leads, building strong client relationships, and converting prospects into business opportunities.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication and negotiation skills and be confident in selling **digital marketing services** to businesses.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate new business opportunities through **cold calling, lead generation**.
* Identify and approach potential **B2B clients** who require digital marketing services.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable digital marketing solutions.
* Handle the complete sales cycle from **lead generation to conversion and closure**.
* Conduct client calls and meetings to present company services and proposals.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and potential clients.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly **sales and revenue targets**.
* Coordinate with the digital marketing team to ensure smooth client onboarding.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, follow-ups, and conversions.
* Stay updated on digital marketing trends, services, and competitor offerings.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* **1–3 years of experience** in Business Development, B2B Sales, Service Sales, Inside Sales, or Client Acquisition.
* Candidates from **Digital Marketing Agencies, IT Services, SaaS, BPO, or other service-based industries** are preferred.
* Good understanding of **digital marketing services** such as SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing, website development, and lead generation.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong convincing, negotiation, and closing abilities.
* Target-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to handle client objections and convert leads into customers.
* Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.

Key Skills

**B2B Sales | Business Development | Lead Generation | Client Acquisition | Cold Calling | Digital Marketing Sales | Inside Sales | Negotiation | Client Relationship Management | Sales Closing**

What We Offer

* Competitive salary + **Incentives**
* Performance-based growth opportunities
* Opportunity to work with diverse B2B clients
* Professional and supportive work environment
* Career growth in the **Digital Marketing & Business Development** field

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Sales Associate to join our Investment Advisory team. This role is designed for students and fresh graduates who want to build a strong foundation in the finance and wealth-management industry.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Engage with potential clients through calls, emails, and messaging platforms to introduce them to our investment offerings.
* Understand basic customer financial needs and communicate relevant product options.
* Generate, qualify, and document leads with accurate client information.
* Schedule consultations and meetings for senior sales managers.
* Maintain CRM records and ensure timely follow-ups to nurture investor interest.
* Assist in organising webinars, workshops, and campaigns focused on financial literacy and investment awareness.
* Stay updated on mutual funds, SIPs, insurance products, and other market-linked instruments (training will be provided).

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or any related field (freshers welcome).
* Basic understanding of financial or investment concepts is a plus, but not mandatory.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Target-driven mindset with eagerness to learn.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools is preferred but not required.

Interested candidates can directly send their CVs at navita.verma@perannum.money along with following details:

1. Current CTC

2. Expected CTC

3. Location

4. Notice Period

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

description:
Job Description: Pre-Sales Executive – Automation Industry

We are currently hiring for the position of **Pre-Sales Executive** at Incygys, an automation and smart building solutions company. Please find the job details below.

**Position:** Pre-Sales Executive  
**Industry:** Automation / Smart Building Solutions  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Job Location:** Near Madhapur Metro Station, Hyderabad

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive Pre-Sales Executive to support the sales team by understanding customer requirements, preparing proposals, coordinating with technical teams, and identifying suitable automation solutions for residential and commercial projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand customer requirements and project specifications.
* Support the sales team in identifying suitable automation and smart building solutions.
* Prepare quotations, proposals, presentations, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate with sales, technical, and project teams to provide suitable solutions.
* Follow up on customer enquiries and support lead conversion.
* Explain product features and solution benefits to customers, architects, builders, consultants, and interior designers.
* Assist in preparing BOQs (Bills of Quantities) and cost estimates.
* Conduct market research to understand customer needs and competitor offerings.
* Maintain customer records, enquiry details, and proposal status in the CRM.
* Support product demonstrations and client meetings when required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, ECE, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience in pre-sales, technical sales, or the automation industry.
* Basic understanding of home automation, smart building systems, ELV, HVAC, or building management systems (BMS) is an advantage.
* Good communication, presentation, and customer-handling skills.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and prepare accurate proposals.
* Strong coordination, problem-solving, and organisational skills.

If You Are Interested

If you are interested in exploring this opportunity, please share your updated CV along with the following details:

* Total years of experience
* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice period
* Current location

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Travel Consultant
description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Outbound Travel Consultant** to manage and convert international travel leads. You will guide customers from the initial inquiry to the final booking, ensuring a seamless and delightful travel experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle and convert outbound (international) travel inquiries received via calls, emails, and online platforms.
* Understand customer preferences and suggest suitable international destinations, itineraries, and experiences.
* Prepare competitive and attractive quotations for outbound holiday packages.
* Coordinate and confirm bookings for flights, hotels, cruises, activities, and transport.
* Provide accurate information on visa requirements, travel insurance, and foreign exchange.
* Maintain updated knowledge of global travel trends, airline routes, and seasonal deals.
* Negotiate with overseas suppliers and DMCs for the best rates and services.
* Upsell additional travel services to increase revenue per booking.
* Ensure timely documentation, ticketing, and pre-departure communication with clients.
* Meet monthly sales and conversion targets.

Job Type: Permanent

Pay: ₹14,299.12 - ₹48,241.98 per month

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC?
* Which all destination you have sold or operated tours so far?

Work Location: In person

title: Travel Consultant
description:

* Understand customer requirements, budget, travel dates and preferences.

* Explain hotels, sightseeing, transfers, activities, inclusions and exclusions clearly.

* Convert qualified leads into confirmed bookings.
